title: Option Traders Are Already Positioning for the Next Move
speaker: Geeks of Finance team (host, Anthony, Shawn)

macro_themes.view: Rising rates make it hard for debt-reliant small businesses to grow, keeping IWM in a downtrend.

calls.reason: New all-time high on four straight up days with +$161M delta-weighted call buying at 7850-7870; the largest GEX is at 7850 and sellers sit at 7900, so dealer selling may cap it above 7850.
calls.quote: total flows in the options market were very positive in the SPX options chain.

calls.reason: IWM has been in a downtrend for months, stalling at the 20-day SMA under the 50-day EMA; rising rates hurt small caps. They rolled short puts down to the 280 strike.
calls.quote: We think that's likely to push IWM lower in the coming sessions.

calls.condition: A weekly close above the 15 EMA (~15.75) could spike VIX toward 20; 17 is the line in the sand
calls.reason: VIX hit the 15 target, closed just above the 9 SMA at 14.92 and has not closed above the weekly 15 EMA since mid-July.
calls.quote: as long as we don't see the VIX moving over that 1575 area, we don't really see any immediate cause for concern.

calls.reason: Heavy bullish 260-265 call buying for this week, with an interim bottom near 245 and the largest GEX at 260.
calls.quote: this looks like a potential continuation for Amazon up through the 260 level by this Friday's expiration.

calls.condition: Re-enter on a dip toward 400; continuation to 450 as long as it holds above 400
calls.reason: Took profit on the 400/425 call debit spread at 17.42 (+121%); still positive GEX up to 450 with some at 500.
calls.quote: as long as it holds above 400, the odds would seem to favor a continuation up toward 450.

calls.condition: Re-enter on further consolidation or a pullback; dealer selling expected near 700
calls.reason: Momentum stock hugging the 10-day SMA with positive GEX at 650 and 700, but more selling at higher strikes may cap it.
calls.quote: We're not chasing AMD here, but I am watching this carefully for any kind of further consolidation or a pullback to reenter
